jobs.title: Senior Training Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Us**


Scorpion is the leading provider of technology and services helping local businesses thrive. We do this by helping customers understand local market dynamics, make the most of their marketing, and deliver experiences their customers will love. We offer tools to know what's going on with marketing, competitors, and customers. We offer a unique blend of AI support and teams of real human people with local expertise committed to customer success. At Scorpion, we are ready to do whatever it takes to help our clients reach their goals. Our technology and personalized tools bring everything together to help local businesses easily understand their unique business, market, and customer needs. We put SEO, Reviews, Advertising, Email Marketing, Chat and Messaging, Social Media, Website, Lead Management, Appointment Scheduling, and more to work for local businesses. We're a technology\-led service with a human touch.### **About the Role**



The Senior Training Specialist owns the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of enablement programs for Customer Success, with a primary focus on onboarding and ongoing skills development for Marketing Assistants and Account Managers. This role independently develops and facilitates training across the Scorpion technology suite (Platform, CSX, CMS, My Site, Enterprise Portal), client communication and service standards, account management practices, and core digital marketing concepts.



Serving as a subject\-matter resource and strategic partner to Customer Success leaders and cross\-functional teams, the Senior Training Specialist identifies learning needs, translates business and performance gaps into effective learning solutions, and uses data and feedback to continuously improve programs. This role helps ensure client\-facing teams build the knowledge, skills, and confidence needed to ramp quickly and perform consistently.


**Internal candidates will receive priority consideration for this role. However, external applications are welcomed and will be reviewed if the position is not filled internally.**



### **What Your Success Will Look Like**


* Own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of onboarding and skills\-training programs for customer\-facing roles, including client communication, service standards, tools, workflows, and turnaround expectations.
* Independently facilitate engaging in\-person and virtual learning experiences, adapting delivery methods and content based on audience needs, performance gaps, and business priorities.
* Design, build, and maintain training curricula, facilitator guides, job aids, assessments, and other enablement resources for the Scorpion technology suite and digital marketing channels, including SEO, paid media, social, and content.
* Assess learning and performance needs in partnership with Customer Success leaders and subject\-matter experts and recommend appropriate training or enablement solutions.
* Own assigned learning paths within the LMS / enablement platform, including curriculum structure, scheduling, enrollment, completion tracking, assessments, and ongoing optimization.
* Analyze learner feedback, assessment results, quality scores, completion data, and performance indicators to evaluate training effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Translate insights from training and performance data into actionable recommendations and implement improvements to programs, content, and learning experiences.
* Maintain and continuously improve the enablement content library, establishing scalable and consistent resources for client\-facing teams.
* Partner with Account Managers, Directors, Customer Success leadership, and cross\-functional support teams to anticipate enablement needs and ensure training reflects evolving tools, products, processes, and client expectations.
* Serve as a subject\-matter resource for Customer Success onboarding, Scorpion technology, client\-service standards, and applicable account management practices.
* Lead or contribute to cross\-functional enablement initiatives and provide recommendations on training approaches, readiness, and adoption for new tools, processes, or programs.
* Mentor and share best practices with other facilitators, trainers, and subject\-matter experts as needed, without direct people\-management responsibility.

### **Who You Are And What You Bring**


* Education
	+ Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Education, or a related field preferred, or equivalent practical experience —or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience
	+ 5\+ years of experience in Enablement, Training, Account Management, Customer Success, Learning \& Development, or a related field, preferably within digital marketing, SaaS, or a client\-service environment; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
	+ Working knowledge of adult learning principles and instructional design methodologies (e.g., ADDIE), with demonstrated ability to apply them when designing and facilitating training programs.
	+ Experience using learner feedback, assessments, performance metrics, or other data to evaluate effectiveness and recommend improvements.
	+ Strong working knowledge of LMS / enablement platforms, Zoom, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office 365; experience with CRM and Customer Success tools preferred.
	+ Strong understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, paid media, social, and content, and how they support client outcomes.
	+ Strong understanding of customer success, account management, and client\-service workflows.
	+ Demonstrated ability to build credibility and influence cross\-functional partners and leaders without direct authority.
* Skills
	+ Strong facilitation and presentation skills with experience adapting content and delivery for different audiences and skill levels.
	+ Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to translate complex concepts into clear, actionable learning experiences.
	+ Ability to independently manage multiple priorities, identify needs, solve problems, and drive work forward with limited oversight.

### **Our Scorpion Values**


* **Winning Mindset:** When our clients win, we win.
* **Genuine Care:** We only succeed when we are truly invested in our clients and each other.
* **Unmatched Results:** We deliver more than expected–and then some–driving the best results and impacting lives.
* **Constant Improvement:** We believe there is always a better way. We learn we ask "What if?" we build and then do it again.
* **Unbeatable Teamwork:** We come from different backgrounds but have the same vision. We only get there by doing it together, as a team.

### **Compensation**



We acknowledge that states have passed legislation promoting pay transparency. As a national employer, Scorpion has made the decision to post our expected pay rate or pay range (as applicable) in all our job postings, regardless of geographic location.


* The base salary range is $80,000 (entry\-level) \- $90,000 (highly experienced), exclusive of fringe benefits. If you are hired at Scorpion, your final base salary compensation will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, and/or experience. Additionally, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members as a part of any final offer. Please keep in mind that the range mentioned above is the total salary range for the role. Hiring at the maximum of the range would not be typical in order to allow for future \& continued salary growth.
* The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of discretionary bonuses or commissions.

### **Our Benefits**



We invest in our employees by offering them diverse benefits from best\-in\-class carriers. These benefits provide enough choice and flexibility to keep our employees and their families healthy and happy—today and tomorrow.


* 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Flexible paid time off, so you can rest, relax, and recharge away from work
* Paid parental leave
* Paid cell phone and service
* Remote office allowance
* Professional development and development courses
* Regular manager check\-ins to drive performance and career growth through Lattice

### **Work Location \& Flexibility**



Scorpion supports a range of work arrangements, including in\-office, hybrid, and remote roles. For positions designated as remote, employees who live within commuting distance of a Scorpion office may be asked to work from the office based on team needs, collaboration opportunities, or business priorities. Specific expectations will be discussed during the interview process.



**Equal Opportunity Employer**



Scorpion is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, military/veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or physical or mental disability. We believe in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion.



\[Reasonable Accommodations]



**Applicant Privacy**



When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to Scorpion. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.


**E\-Verify**



Scorpion participates in the E\-Verify program to confirm employment authorization of all newly hired employees. The E\-Verify process is completed during new hire onboarding and completion of the Form I\-9, Employment Eligibility Verification, at the start of employment. E\-Verify is not used as a tool to pre\-screen candidates. For more information on E\-Verify, please visit www.uscis.gov.

jobs.title: Professional Development Training Specialist, (9012)
jobs.company: Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Washington
jobs.description:
Description:
**ORGANIZATION OVERVIEW:** At Catholic Charities of the Archdiocese of Washington, your knowledge and service in areas such as immigrants and refugees, mental health, social work, employment and adult education, legal and financial services, health care, food assistance, shelter and housing, developmental disabilities and prison outreach can make a profound difference in the lives of many. Through more than 50 programs across the district and five surrounding counties, Catholic Charities is opening doors to help and hope. At CCADW, we continue to build an inclusive culture that celebrates a diverse workforce. We offer so much more than just a job. We offer careers. We take pride in our “promote from within” culture. We offer professional development, a comprehensive benefits package, and a passion for building and motivating world class, high performing teams. Explore your career opportunity with Catholic Charities.

***Join us in Inspiring Hope and Building Futures.***

**JOB SUMMARY:** Responsible for identifying training needs, designing and tailoring instructor – led and online trainings, facilitating trainings and How We Work Operations Orientation, evaluating training effectiveness, and managing training content/materials. Works with internal instructors to ensure consistent and high\-quality delivery of core trainings.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Develop and/or revise instructor\-led and online trainings, including but not limited to:
* Analyze data to assess curriculum, learning and instructional needs,
* Collaborate with instructors and subject matter experts to develop course content,
* Develop and edit instructor manuals, presentation materials, handouts, infographics, and other relevant teaching tools,
* Use of e\-learning authoring tools, as well as knowledge of multimedia learning best practices and graphic design to create online content.
* Facilitate in\-person and virtual training classes, including the learning management system (LMS) training and other courses such as Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR), First Aid, Cultural Competence and Communication, Non\-violent Crisis Intervention (CPI), and Characteristics and Needs of Individuals Served, Ethical Decision Making in Catholic Community Service, and How We Work Operations Orientation.
* Create the block calendar that provides for the quarterly and annual training needs of Catholic Charities employees.
* Coordinate and record the evaluation of efficacy of professional development programs (questionnaires, surveys) and uses the information to guide further planning for workshops and PD programs.
* Contribute to the development and revision of professional development’s department protocols.
* Analyzes data to facilitate the development of best practices and determine instructional needs.
* Train new instructors in Professional Development administration practices, content presentation and facilitation, and learning technologies.
* Lead or co\-lead the “Community of Learning” internal instructors cohort.
* Provide updates on Adult Learning Theory Best Practices
* Writing performance objectives
* Virtual engagement activities
* Technology integration
* When assigned, respond to LMS help desk requests and document learner course completion within the LMS.
* Collaborate with the Director of Professional Development to determine current and anticipated PD needs.
* Lead internal marketing of PD training and events.
* When assigned, serve as the technical assistant for internal and/or external training sessions.
* Backup:
* Provide support for professional development instructors including class reminders, space/materials preparation, and paperwork collection.
* Oversee professional development materials, instructor manuals, equipment, office supplies and training spaces, including room arrangements.
* Serve as professional development registrar, including customer service (LMS helpdesk) and LMS system management (class loading, registration, and class closing based on class sign\-in sheets). Maintain training documentation.
* Schedule training sessions, coordinate list of instructors, and oversee LMS registration procedures, along with ensuring that the facility is properly set up and PD staff members are notified of assignments, issues or concerns.
* Communicate with instructors about training and paperwork requirements.
* Create compliance reports to include but not limited to: CPR/FA, CPI, Bloodborne Pathogens, and New Employee Program (Site)Orientation Checklist.
* Maintain department electronic and/or physical records ensuring they are created, filed and organized.
* Perform other job\-related duties as assigned.


Requirements:
**EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* Minimum 3 years’ experience in a learning and development, curriculum development, instructional design, or human capital work environment, ideally in a social services or behavioral health setting.
* Experience with a learning management system preferred.
* Experience teaching or public speaking preferred.

**SKILLS and COMPETENCIES:**

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite applications including Word, Excel, \& PowerPoint. Ability to operate job\-related equipment including the use of basic computer programs and systems to effectively carry out the duties of the position.
* Excellent organization, communication, interpersonal, collaboration, and relationship skills.

**Benefits Package:**

* **Robust Professional development and training opportunities**
* Medical, prescriptions, dental and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plan with company match
* Company\-paid and supplemental life insurance
* Short Term/ Long Term disability
* Group Life Insurance and AD\&D
* Other Volunteer Insurance Benefits
* Flexible spending accounts
* Paid vacation, sick and personal leave
* 11 paid holidays
* Tuition reimbursement
* Employee referral bonus program
* Parenting leave
* Pet’s Insurance

**Work Schedule:** Monday \- Friday, 8:30 AM \- 5:00 PM

jobs.title: Court Reporting Onboarding & Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Remote Legal**  

At Remote Legal, our 40\-year legacy is built on the expertise of seasoned attorneys and dedicated court reporters who are passionate about transforming the legal process. We're not a flash\-in\-the\-pan tech startup—instead, we blend time\-honored legal experience with innovative technology to redefine how depositions are conducted. Our team spans legal professionals, product owners, engineers, client\-success leads, and security specialists, all collaborating seamlessly to ensure every deposition is a success. Join us, and become part of a community where rich experience meets forward\-thinking innovation, and where your talents help make the legal journey better for everyone. **About the role**  

The Reporter Training Specialist\- Testimony Capture is responsible for sourcing, onboarding, and training court reporters within the Testimony Capture department. This role helps design and maintain training programs, documentation, and quality standards to ensure reporters are fully prepared to deliver high\-quality services. Works cross\-functionally with Operations, Assignments, Production, and Customer Support to support reporter readiness, platform proficiency, and ongoing performance.

 **What you'll do*** Sources court reporters through approved recruiting platforms, including Rippling
* Conducts interviews, evaluates qualifications, and supports hiring decisions for reporters
* Manages onboarding process, including documentation, system access, and initial readiness checks
* Trains reporters on company processes, operational expectations, and quality standards
* Delivers training on Remote Legal platforms and related technology tools
* Creates, maintains, and updates training scenarios, guides, and reference materials
* Develops procedures and training documentation to support consistency and quality across reporting team
* Coordinates with Operations and Assignments to identify training needs and performance gaps
* Provides refresher training, updates, and process rollouts as procedures evolve
* Supports remediation and targeted retraining when quality or compliance issues are identified
* Maintains accurate training records and onboarding documentation for reporters
* Monitors training effectiveness and recommends improvements based on feedback and outcomes
* Ensures training aligns with legal, procedural, and company standards
* Develop, review, and update the quality rubric to ensure alignment with company standards
* Establish and enforce a consistent cadence for feedback
* Facilitate and lead regular quality calibration sessions
* Create and distribute detailed feedback based on quality reviews and audits
* Review markups and scorecards prepared by others for accuracy and consistency
* Maintains strict confidentiality of all company, client, and reporter information
* Recruits, onboards, trains, and oversees direct reports as assigned; provides coaching, guidance, and development
* Sets team priorities, allocates workload, and ensures coverage for onboarding, training delivery, and quality reviews
* Leads performance management activities for direct reports, including goal setting, ongoing feedback, documentation, and support for corrective action when needed
* Establishes repeatable team workflows, documentation standards, and knowledge\-sharing routines to support consistent delivery and coverage
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Qualifications*** Strong training, facilitation, and instructional design skills
* Ability to clearly communicate processes and technical concepts
* Strong organizational and documentation skills
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding and training workflows simultaneously
* High attention to detail and quality standards
* Problem\-solving mindset with ability to adapt training to reporter needs
* Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop team members in a remote environment
* Comfort working in a fast\-paced, remote environment
* Experience with court reporting workflows or legal proceedings preferred
* Ability to collaborate cross\-functionally with multiple departments

**Education and Experience**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience).
* 2\-5 years of professional experience, including:


o Experience in training, onboarding, operations, or related roles
o Experience in legal, court reporting, or related environments **W****ork Environment*** This is a primarily remote position performed from a home office or approved remote work location; limited travel may be required periodically for training, meetings, or other business needs.
* All work is conducted through secure, company\-approved technology platforms via computer, phone, and video conferencing platforms.
* Reliable high\-speed internet access and a private, secure workspace are required.

**Physical Requirements**

* Ability to work for extended periods at a computer workstation in a remote, home\-based environment.
* Ability to perform repetitive motions, including frequent typing, keyboarding, and use of a mouse or other input devices.
* Ability to view computer screens, read digital documents, and analyze information for prolonged periods.
* Ability to occasionally adjust or move home office equipment weighing up to 10 pounds
* Some evening or weekend work may be required depending on client needs or emergency situations.
* Ability to travel to surrounding areas or states as needed.
